package.name: theta_star_planner_node
package.description: Standalone Theta* planner node. Wraps a vendored copy of nav2_theta_star_planner's ThetaStar search behind a ComputePathToPose action server, building its planning costmap from a traversability PointCloud2 instead of the full Nav2 costmap/lifecycle stack. Drop-in alternative to smac_planner_node (same ROS interface).
